links.comparator_used: Pre-implementation baseline, before the EHR-integrated CAMBRA tool (July 2022), described only as under 5% completion. The abstract does not describe the earlier workflow.
links.effect: CRA completion rose from under 5% to a peak of 89% in March 2024. Provider agreement with algorithm-generated risk levels exceeded 96% after a mandatory confirmation field was introduced in November 2023.
links.tradeoff: The gain was confounded with the POHM curriculum and faculty calibration, which were named as key drivers of adoption. Completion varied by student group, reflecting the importance of consistent faculty leadership.
links.quote: Following EHR-integrated CAMBRA tool implementation in July of 2022, CRA completion rates rose from under 5% to a peak of 89% in March of 2024.

design_hint: mandatory clinician confirmation of algorithm-generated risk plus faculty calibration and staff training
